steps.say: Weather is what the air outside is like each day.
We measure weather with tools. A thermometer measures temperature.
A rain gauge measures rain. A windsock shows which way the wind blows.
Much of Indonesia has a rainy season and a dry season.

figure.alt: Rain for the rainy season and sun for the dry season.

steps.say: Some countries have four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter.
In a thunderstorm, go inside a building.

figure.alt: Lightning in a storm and a house to shelter in.

check.prompt: Which tool measures how much rain falls?

options.why: A windsock shows which way the wind blows.

hints: This tool collects rain in a container.
Ask: which tool has rain in its name?
check.explanation: A rain gauge collects rain and shows how much fell.

check.prompt: In which season do rivers fill up and puddles form?

options.why: Little rain falls in the dry season, so rivers are low.
Spring is a season in countries with four seasons.
Most of Indonesia does not have a cold winter.

hints: Rivers fill up after lots of rain.
Ask: which season brings lots of rain?
check.explanation: In the rainy season lots of rain falls, so rivers fill up and puddles form.
